text: For the director of music. A psalm of David. Blessed is he who has regard for the weak; the Lord delivers him in times of trouble.
he will bless him in the land and not surrender him to the desire of his foes.
and restore him from his bed of illness.
heal me, for I have sinned against you.”
“When will he die and his name perish?”
he speaks falsely, while his heart gathers slander; then he goes out and spreads it abroad.
they imagine the worst for me, saying,
he will never get up from the place where he lies.”
he who shared my bread, has lifted up his heel against me.
raise me up, that I may repay them.
for my enemy does not triumph over me.
and set me in your presence forever.
from everlasting to everlasting. Amen and Amen.
